name: Working Capital & Cash Flow core scenarios
description: Real Working Capital & Cash Flow Q&A pairs grounded in cash conversion cycle trends, accounts receivable aging, accounts payable early discounts, and liquidity forecasts.

parts.text: What is our Cash Conversion Cycle trend and DSO performance over the past 6 months?

Our Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) improved steadily from 41.7 days in January 2026 to 30.5 days in June 2026. Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) dropped from 38.5 days to 35.0 days, while operating cash flow increased to $1.82M in June.
Which customer accounts have accounts receivable balances overdue by more than 60 days with high bad debt risk?

Summit Department Stores (CUST-102) has $30,000 overdue past 60 days ($20K in 61-90 days, $10K in 90+ days) and Pinnacle Boutiques (CUST-106) has $15,000 past 60 days ($10K in 61-90 days, $5K in 90+ days). Both accounts carry a bad debt risk flag.
What is our accounts payable aging breakdown and how much early payment discount eligible cash can we capture?

Total accounts payable current due is $444,000 across vendors. Summit Outdoor (VND-002) has $50,000 and Alpine Tech (VND-004) has $40,000 eligible for 2/10 Net 30 early payment discounts, totaling $90,000 in early discount eligible funds.
What is our projected 30-day liquidity forecast and closing cash balance through late August 2026?

Opening cash balance of $5.0M on July 24, 2026 is projected to maintain strong liquidity, closing at $4.75M by August 28, 2026, with weekly AR collections averaging $880K against AP disbursements and operating expenses.
